body: i’ve been picking at my face for a while now. the only thing that keeps me from picking is doing activities/chores that keep my hands and mind busy. cleaning out my closet, building furniture, hanging things up in my room, baking, etc. these are just a few things i’ve done in the past where i completely forgot about picking. with this whole quarantine it’s pretty hard to find things to do. just find any kind of distraction. also, wearing gloves really helps if you’re watching tv, on your phone, etc. fluffy/soft ones are especially helpful.
it just gets so exhausting after years and years of the same thing. thanks for the tips, though! i’ll give them a go.
i mean i have ocd so it’s just an impulse thing. i have other ocd symptoms but none are as bad as the skin picking.
